statement: Source read of the captured canonical experiment_protocol.py shows seeds_table emits empty seed values for harness_drawn and lint_export skips protocol-derived seed-table comparison for that method. Therefore harness_drawn metadata/schema acceptance alone does not enforce the proposed fixed named target/seed mapping. The new native collector/auditor/export fixed-identity gate must remain explicit and independently tested; no checker execution or canonical acceptance is asserted by this source review.
